title: Payment Service database connection timeout
description: Customers received HTTP 500 errors while attempting to complete payments.
symptoms: Payment requests failed intermittently and database connections reached the configured pool limit.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by a connection leak in the payment service.
resolution: Increased the connection pool from 50 to 100, restarted the service, and deployed the connection cleanup fix.

title: Authentication JWT validation failures
description: Users were unable to log in after the authentication service rejected valid tokens.
symptoms: Large number of valid sessions were rejected after a signing key reached expiration.
resolution: Rotated the JWT signing key, updated the authentication configuration, and restarted the authentication service.

title: Order Service Redis connection failure
description: Order creation requests became slow and eventually failed.
symptoms: Cache requests timed out and order API latency increased significantly.
root_cause: Redis primary node became unavailable during a maintenance event.
resolution: Failed over to the Redis replica and restarted affected application instances.

title: Inventory database deadlock
description: Inventory updates started failing during a high-volume flash sale.
symptoms: Multiple inventory update transactions were rolled back.
root_cause: Concurrent transactions acquired database locks in inconsistent order.
resolution: Rolled back the problematic deployment and changed transaction lock ordering.

title: Notification queue backlog
description: Customers experienced delayed email and SMS notifications.
symptoms: Queue depth increased continuously and notification processing latency exceeded 20 minutes.
root_cause: Notification workers were processing messages slower than the incoming event rate.
resolution: Scaled notification workers from 4 to 12 and restarted two unhealthy workers.

title: API Gateway upstream timeout
description: Several API endpoints returned gateway timeout responses.
symptoms: Gateway requests exceeded the configured upstream timeout while backend latency increased.
root_cause: Order Service response latency increased after an inefficient database query was deployed.
resolution: Rolled back the database query change and increased monitoring on backend latency.

title: Checkout payment provider timeout
description: Checkout requests failed when communicating with the external payment provider.
symptoms: Checkout requests remained pending and eventually returned timeout errors.
root_cause: External payment provider experienced elevated response latency.
resolution: Enabled retry with exponential backoff and temporarily routed traffic through the secondary payment provider.

title: User Service database connection exhaustion
description: Profile requests returned intermittent server errors.
symptoms: Database connections remained active longer than expected and request failures increased.
root_cause: A recently deployed code path failed to release database connections.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment, restarted the service, and deployed a connection cleanup patch.

title: Shipping API third-party failure
description: Shipment creation failed for a portion of customer orders.
symptoms: Requests to the external courier API returned service unavailable responses.
root_cause: Third-party courier API experienced an outage.
resolution: Enabled the secondary courier integration and queued failed shipment requests for retry.

title: Product Service cache inconsistency
description: Customers saw outdated product inventory information.
symptoms: Product availability differed between the product page and inventory service.
root_cause: Cache invalidation events were not being delivered after inventory updates.
resolution: Cleared affected cache entries and repaired the cache invalidation event consumer.
